eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED MONTHLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Yakima, WA; at 6:51 AM on AUG 11, 2023 Effective until 2:51 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Required Monthly Test (RMT) of the local emergency alert system for Yakima County Washington.
